Apple (AAPL) Holder Family Management Has Lowered Stake; Amg National Trust Bank Has Increased Hormel (HRL) Stake by $1.87 Million
April 25, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
Family Management Corp decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 17.41% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Family Management Corp sold 17,719 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 84,082 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $14.23 million, down from 101,801 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Family Management Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $837.01 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.24% or $2.02 $164.96. About 16.40 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Amg National Trust Bank increased its stake in Hormel (HRL) by 12.45% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Amg National Trust Bank bought 52,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.60% with the market. The institutional investor held 469,601 shares of the meat and poultry and fish company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $17.09 million, up from 417,601 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Amg National Trust Bank who had been investing in Hormel for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $19.17 billion market cap company. It closed at $36.2 lastly. It is down 1.70% downtrending. It has underperformed by 13.25% the S&P500.
Among 54 analysts covering Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 35 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 65% are positive.
